The '''Emperor's personal shuttle''', also known as '''Palpatine's personal shuttle''', was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] used by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:EmperorPalpatinesShuttle-GalacticHunters.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Emperor Palpatine exiting his shuttle.]]
The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] featured a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] and was marked by a [[Color/Legends|grey]] stripe on its nose.<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{SWE|technology|imperialshuttle|Imperial shuttle}}</ref> It was presumably crewed only by a limited number of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guardsmen]].

==History==
[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] used it often on trips throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Palpatine's shuttle was hit at least once in its career with the Emperor inside, in a premature (and inadvertent) shooting by attempted assassin [[Raygar]]. Raygar had been attempting to aim at the pod of a couple of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]]; Raygar was punished by the Emperor for "[[Treason/Legends|high treason]]" after the incident, with the latter personally delivering it.<ref name="Battle for the Sunstar">{{Ewoks|Battle for the Sunstar}}</ref>

During the [[Battle of Korriban (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Korriban]]. Renegade Squadron are tasked to steal a data pack aboard Palpatine's shuttle during the latter's pilgrimage at Korriban. Which is one of the ambush plans in preparation for the Battle of Endor.

[[File:The_Emperors_Arrival_AoRCR.png|thumb|right|250px|Palpatine disembarks his shuttle onto the second Death Star.]]
He used the shuttle to reach the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Upon arrival, it disembarked at [[Hangar 272/Legends|Hangar 272]], with the Imperials honoring his arrival with air parades outside the station and the personnel, including a large amount of [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and military personnel standing at attention regarding their ruler arrival. The shuttle was destroyed when the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] was destroyed during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Return of the Jedi (radio)|''Return of the Jedi'' radio dramatization]] states that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] escaped the second Death Star in Palpatine's shuttle. The novel ''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]'' counters this by stating that the escape was made in [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[ST 321/Legends|shuttle]]. [[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'']] states that Palpatine's shuttle was destroyed with the second Death Star, confirming that Luke did not use this ship. In addition, in the film itself, the shuttle in question lacked the gray stripe on its front, and the ship under close inspection was seen leaving from a small docking bay rather than the larger one, further confirming that the shuttle in question was not Palpatine's ship.
